text: Ireland’s overall risk of sovereign stress is low, reflecting low near- and medium-term vulnerabilities alongside moderate long-term risks. Public debt fell by more than 20 pp since the onset of the pandemic, but stands elevated at 62 percent of GNI* in 2025. Total pension expenditure is projected to rise from 3.8 percent of GDP in 2022 to 6.6 percent in 2070. Staff assesses long-term risks as moderate due to unfavorable demographic trends, highlighting the need for reforms to safeguard pension system sustainability and a cost-efficient healthcare system.
